text:
Noelle Kim: PolarisGrid sent an RFI asking for a compact capability matrix, a POC scope, and explicit answers on BYOK/HSM, VPC peering, and token-level audit/egress controls. They also asked whether we support model pinning + quantized variants for cost control. Uploaded here: s3://redwood-sales/polarisgrid/polaris-rfi-2026.pdf

Arjun Desai: Proposed POC: 4 business days. Day 0 prep & security review, Day 1 data ingest + index, Day 2 perf/scale with simulated 200 concurrent sessions, Day 3 embedding quality + cost profiling, Day 4 handoff + runbook. Include a small replay harness and token-cost dashboard export.

Kelvin Y.: Pricing sketch: $5k platform credits, $1.5k infra stipend if on-prem infra required, and an optional temp Dedicated pool charge. Offer throughput-based discount tiers if they commit to a 3-month Dedicated reservation after POC. Finance to sign off.

Noelle Kim: Customer asked explicitly: can we pin a model version and serve a quantized variant for lower cost while keeping identical API semantics? Also asked about per-token logging for egress audits.

Arjun Desai: Answer draft: Yes — model pinning is supported via versioned artifacts in the model catalog; Dedicated and Private let you pin down to a specific build+quantization profile. Quantized variants are available for supported architectures; we document expected latency/quality tradeoffs per model.

Kelvin Y.: On per-token logging: we can provide aggregated token metrics and per-request metadata. Full per-token text logging is only available under strict DPA terms due to privacy and storage costs; we can offer signed attestations of egress volumes and a token-level billing export (no raw user text unless NDA+DPA+SOW allow ingestion).

Jules (legal): NDA + DPA required before ingestion. If they request per-token text logs then we need explicit consent and a narrow SOW limiting retention & scope. We'll prepare a DPA addendum for egress-logging and a short SOW template. Pen-test requires a scoped plan and 10 business days notice.

Noelle Kim: Security Qs: BYOK + HSM import? Key export policy? Regional KMS support? Also network: can we support VPC peering and SAML/SCIM user provisioning for the POC?

Arjun Desai: BYOK: supported via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault for Hosted Enterprise; Private supports PKCS#11 HSM import. Key export: we do NOT permit export of private key material from HSMs. VPC peering: supported in Dedicated and Private. SAML/SCIM provisioning: available for Dedicated & Private via our SSO integrations; for Hosted we can enable SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning under enterprise onboarding.

Kelvin Y.: Note: if they want on-prem inference accelerators (customer-owned GPUs) we can discuss Private deployment model but on-prem hardware integration is a separate professional services scope. Mention in matrix.

Noelle Kim: I'll draft the capability matrix with these columns: Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private | Notes (limitations, add-ons). Rows include: tenant isolation, model pinning, quantized variants, per-tenant KMS, HSM import, key export policy, VPC peering, SAML/SCIM, token audit exports, retention controls, SOC2/ISO artifacts.

Arjun Desai: Small deliverable: include an example embeddings curl and a short command to pull the token-billing export:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'

# get billing export (example)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/exports?range=last_7d

Noelle Kim: I'll push deliverables to s3://redwood-sales/polarisgrid/deliverables/: capability_matrix_polaris_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_polaris.md, poc_quote_polaris.pdf. Aiming to return the RFI within 24 hours.

Jules (legal): Uploaded DPA templates and a narrow SOW snippet. If they request per-token text logs we'll need to negotiate retention, access controls, and indemnities. I'll fast-track review once deliverables are in the folder.

Scheduler (ops-bot): Calendar: tentative POC kickoff 2026-10-05 09:00 PDT  invite sent to polaris-poc@polarisgrid.com.

Kelvin Y.: Tech note: when we list quantized variants, include expected p50 latency and a small quality delta note per internal evaluation. Also call out that caching/prefix reuse can reduce token cost for conv. workloads ~15%.

Noelle Kim: Thanks team  please review the draft matrix and RFI answers once I upload. If finance/legal OK I'll send this afternoon. :thumbsup:
